ai_summary: Accuracy Shipping Limited reported a sharp decline in profitability for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, with Q2 net profit dropping 58% year-over-year and 39% sequentially, alongside a 10% YoY revenue decrease. This material impact on earnings is compounded by significantly increased borrowings and trade receivables, hinting at potential working capital and liquidity challenges. A key red flag is the substantial profit reduction amid rising debt and an incomplete cash flow statement provided in the document.
